purpose: Own spawn point waves: authored wave config, trigger-started queue, the level-wide cap on living infected and where the wave appears.
state_owner: Which spawn points have fired this mission
Pending wave queue and the infected a wave spawned

spawn_wave_v1.configure_spawn: configure_spawn(config: Dictionary) -> void; spawn_config.gd config is {queues: [queue]} (up to 8), queue keys enemies [{enemy, count}] (up to 6 kinds), interval, rule, batch, start (time|trigger; the first queue always trigger), delay, trigger, health, damage (percents 50-200 applied to each spawned infected via configure_stats); a flat legacy {enemy, count, ...} is read as one queue; get_spawn_config() returns the repaired config
spawn_wave_v1.trigger_meta: wave_director.TRIGGER_META (spawn_triggers) on a placed infected lists link keys (spawn_config.link_key: the point id for its first queue, id#n for queue n+1) whose queue its death can start; one infected may link to many points and queues; each queue fires once, a timed queue starts delay seconds after the previous queue started
spawn_wave_v1.cap: wave_director.max_alive (90) bounds living infected on the level; queued waves wait for a free slot and take turns
spawn_wave_v1.spawned: spawned infected are ordinary scenes added to the enemies root with set_target(player); meta spawned_by holds the point id and spawned_queue the queue index
